Episode 184. Overcoming Destiny (8)
Screeeech…!
With the ominous resonance as the Magic Stone opened, a massive flame spread throughout the entire battlefield.
Knights who rushed in like a swarm of bees were swept away by the flames, forming a river of burning corpses.
Beradin incinerated the enemies with a bland expression on his face, as if he were burning trash.
'Eventually, my comrade has come to use that ominous power directly... Moreover, that figure is similar to Kellic Zack, isn't it?!'
Dante pushed down the bitter feeling rising in his chest and broke through the enemy lines.
He couldn't accept the changed appearance of Beradin.
The Magic Stone, chaos, and other horrifying powers beyond human norms and reason were destroying his family, land, and friends. They were driving them towards death.
'Jin, are you alright…?!'
Dante swung his sword around as if venting his anger.
The Knights of Chaos were sliced into pieces, their fragments scattering in all directions, ceaselessly.
While Kadun and Vail, who were leading the charge, were slowed down due to evading friendly fire and magic, Dante was cutting through enemy lines unhindered.
The bright glow emanating from Rashid appeared eerily ghost-like.
The first thing to make Dante falter was Lionel's sword.
Vroom-! Bang!
When Dante blocked a straightforward blow, a massive half-moon shaped crater was formed on the ground.
Feeling a twinge in his lower body and waist, Dante widened his eyes.
[You seem to be filled with rage, young Sword Emperor.]
Lionel, who reached the zenith of swordsmanship, left an afterimage, inflicting shallow wounds all over Dante's body.
"Aren't you angry? Seeing the family you once led fall so low."
Lionel smirked and focused his gaze on Rashid.
[Corruption in the name of becoming stronger is just another name for struggle. Whether the choice of the Clan Leader and the 12 Disciples was right will be completely proven after the war.]
Whish!
This time, an invisible sword aura grazed Lionel's cheek.

[An invisible sword, huh... Interesting. Your grandfather was the first to achieve this, wasn't he? I can't understand what this era has come to. So many who would have been absolute in my time, this is truly a brilliant age!]
Lionel laughed hysterically, as if he was genuinely enjoying himself.
Their swords clashed, dispersing his laughter.
However, Dante couldn't fully concentrate on the battle.

The mismatched reasons between Jin and the Allied Forces, the broken Beradin, the increased number of Chaos Army soldiers despite thousands already killed, and his own emotional control not working at this critical moment.
All these elements mingled together, producing an inexplicable discomfort.
"Am I worried about Jin? Or is it because there are too many enemies? I need to concentrate, but why all of a sudden...?"
Just moments ago, he was piercing through enemy lines with rage, but now, with a formidable enemy before him, his mind is scattered.
After reaching this state, no, even before he became this powerful, Dante had never experienced such a state of distraction.
Especially during battle.
Lionel did not miss that fact.
"It's a first to have someone thinking of something else with me in front of them. Will you be alright? Young Sword Emperor, unlike me, you only have one life!"
With a sound of clashing, Dante, who blocked Lionel's horizontal attack, was pushed back dozens of steps to the left and tumbled on the ground.
His stance had crumbled due to his delayed reaction.
And Dante was not the only one who fell nearby.
Another clan leader, who had just started fighting with Vail, was lodged next to Dante.
He immediately stood up and swung his twin swords towards Vail, who was charging again, and Dante also corrected his stance while avoiding Lionel's follow-up sword energy.
"Hey, Dante! Why are you being pushed by such a guy? Are you not fighting properly? Why are your eyes so blank?"
Vail, who was saying this, didn't seem to be in a position to help Dante right away.
Dante's gaze was once again stolen by the clan leader fighting Vail.
"On his face... what's that chain?"
The clan leader also had a chain wrapped around his face like Alpen.
It was evidence that he was resisting Rosa, but the allies here did not yet know that fact.
The reason Vail couldn't easily push his opponent right now was precisely because Rosa was controlling him.
Vail was used to a battle of suppressing the opponent with pure destructive power rather than the subtlety of swordsmanship, so the compatibility was particularly bad.
However, Dante unconsciously shouted at Vail.
"Knight Vail, before you kill him, first remove the chain on his face!"
He didn't know why.
Somehow, he had a strong intuition that the pressure weighing him down like old stagnation would disappear if Vail cut off that clan leader's chain.
"What? Why the chain? Besides, are you in a position to command me?"
"It's not a command, it's a request. Please do so!"
"You're noisy, I'm just going to kill him."
Dante then glanced at the clan leader facing Cadun. There was no chain on him.
Again, Vail was facing the chained clan leader towards the left battlefield, and Dante was heading towards the center of the battlefield while parrying Lionel's charging sword.
"Ho, so you couldn't concentrate because you knew the effect of the chain? I'm curious how you found out."
Instead of answering, Dante scattered his invisible sword energy.
"Is it because my senses are duller than usual? I was planning to take control of the melee and buy time to gather my thoughts.
[Your intentions are obvious. Besides, it doesn't suit your overly righteous sword.]
Lionel instantly exploded with his spirit, erasing the invisible sword energy that filled the air.
On the other hand, Dante was put in a situation where he had to follow Lionel's flow.
Moreover, because Lionel mentioned 'the effect of the chain' just now, his nerves were even more focused on that.
While being on the defensive, Dante was constantly stealing glances towards Veil.
It seemed like he could only fight properly if he witnessed the chain breaking.
[Sword Emperor, I wondered why you've been acting strange... You're distracted.]
As Lionel said, Dante's current state was no different from being distracted.
He could lose his life if he was distracted for a moment in a dire situation where he could not keep his focus.
The residual injuries on Dante's body gradually deepened.
Yet, Dante was more conscious of the chain of the Grand Duke who was in battle with Veil than Lionel's sword.
Even Veradin, who was showering magic from above covering the entire battlefield, was looking down at Dante, unable to understand.
'What on earth is Dante Hiran, the Sword Emperor, doing right now? With the enemy general right in front of him.'
'Please break, quickly...!'
Clang!
At the moment Dante's desperate heart reached its peak, Veil broke the chain of the Grand Duke.
Just like Alpen, the sight of a strong and clear face not tainted by chaos was revealed.
As soon as the chain was broken, he sheathed the sword aimed at Veil.

[I, a weak descendant who has sinned, greet you, Knight Veil. I am Tasha Runcandel, the 21st head of the family. Thanks to our ancestor for releasing the bondage, I can finally wield a sword with my will, not as a monster...]
Tasha Runcandel.
She was the daughter of Alpen Runcandel, the 20th head, and the 21st head. Like her father, she was not subject to the power of the monster.
Veil stared at Tasha with a shocked face.
She had a face very similar to Sara.
[Oh... So, the chain was a kind of restraint?]

[Yes, ancestor. Please forgive me for the disrespect I dared to commit under the control of the monster. And may I have your permission to fight with the current 12th generation of Runcandel from now on?]
Tasha had also understood the current situation through her inner self while being bound by the power of the monster.
[I don't have the authority for that... I'm sure he would welcome it with open arms.]
[It is an honor.]
As soon as she finished speaking, Tasha's eyes were filled with severe determination and fighting spirit.
Of course, the place those eyes were directed towards was not the temporary allies, but the army of chaos.
Ah!
At that moment, Dante could finally realize. What had dragged him into despair until now.
'I can return... Veradine too! Just like that, it is possible to return!'
Just as Tasha Runcandel is now shedding her puppet status and shining with Runcandel's will again.
Even his friend, Veradine, who has become a monster to the point of not hesitating to use the magic stone, can definitely return.
As this thought took hold, his endlessly scattered mind was momentarily calming down.
The pressure to fulfill the role that he, as the imperial first sword, must definitely show in this war against the endless chaos army and protecting Jin.
None of those were problems.
Jin will eventually win, and the chaos army, Dante's firm belief that it will forever disappear from this world today, has never wavered from the start.
He was just scared that after the final battle, Veradine might not return to his original self and become another chaos monster.
That was the only thing that disturbed Dante's inner peace while fighting Lionel.
The sight of Tasha, who has escaped from chaos and is now pointing her sword towards chaos, could only come as a strong prophecy to Dante.
Lionel's sword was flying towards Dante's head.
Without even turning his body that way, Dante formed an invisible sword wind.
Unlike the previous times, which had been erased without strength, Lionel could not pierce through that sword wind.
"Your words are correct, Lion King. I was in despair just a moment ago."
[Finally, you seem to be coming to your senses.]

"But since the day you revived, you have been falling deeper into the abyss. That's why you, who were once the supreme ruler of swordsmanship, have not been able to cut down me, who has been fiercely standing till now. You probably don't even know that death is approaching you."
[What are you talking about... Huuh!]
Suddenly, Lionel exhaled a rough breath and looked down at his side.
Death, the sword symbolizing Yona, was piercing through his side.
"Hehe."
Yona evaded Lionel's rough hand and disappeared into the chaos of the battlefield in an instant.

"I warned you that my life, unlike yours, is only one, Lion King. Your sword has become dull due to your continuous resurrection and belief in the chaos. After waking up from the grave, how many times have you died?"
Dante, who is closing the distance in a single breath.
"Please, I hope this is the last. I will wish for you to escape from the swamp of chaos, even in death."
Shack!
Rashid passed Lionel's neck.
With a thud, a trivial noise of the falling neck was heard.
Dante, who is turning his head to find the remaining master of the generation, caught the sight of Tasha and Veradine.
'Even though we've missed each other, if we keep moving towards the chaos fortress, we'll soon run into each other again, Jin. I believe that this scene will give you strength too.'
